name: What is the difference between air sealing and insulation, and do I need both?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between air sealing and insulation, and do I need both?

acceptedAnswer.text: Air sealing focuses on blocking air leakage through cracks and gaps in your home's structure, while insulation resists heat flow through building materials. Both are critical for a truly energy-efficient home. Insulation alone cannot prevent drafts or air infiltration if significant air leaks remain; conversely, sealing leaks without adequate insulation will not optimize thermal performance. Our comprehensive approach often involves assessing and upgrading both air sealing and insulation simultaneously to create a robust thermal envelope that enhances functionality and comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Air sealing blocks air leaks, while insulation resists heat flow. Both are necessary for an energy-efficient home, and we often address them together for optimal performance.
